name: rotifer-gene
description: The Gene manual for Rotifer Protocol — write a Gene's express function and phenotype schema, run the four-layer security audit before publishing, and migrate a Gene's fidelity from Wrapped to Hybrid or Native. Invoke explicitly when building, auditing, or upgrading a Rotifer Gene. Not for general code review, dependency auditing, or framework migration — every procedure operates on Rotifer Genes and the Rotifer CLI.
tagline: The reference for building, auditing and upgrading a Gene
author: rotifer-protocol
